head: d59d20b93b592f17a33d6676d8acbb3a33e2e80f
scope: Implement all actionable post-P6 parity issues #41-#48 end to end: trust and read security, durable index safety, code retrieval/ranking, typed multi-language authority, transactional ChangeSet application, repo map/structural/query ergonomics, memory/session/lifecycle parity decision and surfaces, and repeatable benchmarks.
non_goals: Do not implement hosted tenancy, billing, cloud deployment, remote overlays, or enterprise regional isolation; those remain explicit deferred non-goals.
Do not implement the full session latent-memory product unless the parity decision issue determines a bounded local surface is required.
Do not add external dependencies unless already available or strictly necessary for an acceptance-tested capability.
Do not weaken existing fail-closed security or honesty labels.
risks: This is a broad multi-issue change touching public contracts, security, persistence, retrieval, and workflow application semantics.
Native language parsers, external rerankers, and LSP/SCIP integrations may be unavailable; fallback behavior must remain explicit and tested.
Changing local HTTP/MCP trust defaults can affect existing clients; preserve safe loopback defaults and document migration.
Transactional filesystem changes can lose work if stale-base and rollback checks are incomplete.
